control.name: CONTROL — arm perf unconditionally (the off-by-default floor is gone; an unset switch writes a record)

mutations.name: loosen the switch from exact "1" to a truthiness test (ASSAY_TELEMETRY=true arms recording)
mutations.new: func Enabled() bool { v := os.Getenv(EnvVar); return v != "" && v != "0" }

mutations.name: widen the field allowlist by one planted value: the verb field carries the argv (repo, PR, branch, path)
mutations.old: rec := sess.Finish(perfTool(tool), verb, perfRole(os.Getenv("DESK_LOOP")), code, sha)
mutations.new:
verb = strings.Join(args, " ")
	rec := sess.Finish(perfTool(tool), verb, perfRole(os.Getenv("DESK_LOOP")), code, sha)

mutations.name: widen the field allowlist by one planted value: the role field carries DESK_SESSION
mutations.old: perfrec.New(perfTool(tool), verb, perfRole(os.Getenv("DESK_LOOP")), wall, exit, sha, perfNow())
mutations.new: perfrec.New(perfTool(tool), verb, perfRole(os.Getenv("DESK_LOOP"))+os.Getenv("DESK_SESSION"), wall, exit, sha, perfNow())

mutations.name: relax the pruner's exact day-file match to a prefix match (a day-prefixed decoy is deleted)
widen the retention window past 7 days (the day-8 file survives the prune)
make resultForExit return (an encoding of) its input instead of one of its own constants
propagate the perf write error into the verb's exit code (a full disk turns a green verb red)

_note: Mutations that target the shared writer name it by a path relative to tools/desk (run sequentially from there: go run ./cmd/muhar -spec internal/deskkit/perf-mutations.json). The writer lives in the perfrec module; deskkit's tests exercise it through PerfRun.
